high_level_description: The image shows the back of an Indian PAN (Permanent Account Number) card. The card is predominantly blue with a decorative pattern that includes swirls and floral designs. At the top right corner of the card, there is a metallic emblem featuring a keyhole design, which is part of the official PAN card branding. The text on the card provides instructions for what to do if the card is lost or found. It reads: "In case this card is lost/found, kindly inform/return to: Income Tax PAN Services Unit, UTIITSL Plot No. 3, Sector 11, CBD Belapur, Navi
